nodes.label: B-005 — Disposition the Untracked sync-docs Skill
nodes.description: Lane B found an untracked skill file outside the reviewed commit that contradicted the governing lane map, and refused to treat it as closure evidence. Answered by removing it as a divergent duplicate and repairing the tracked original.
nodes.rationale: Lane B declined to edit, stage, delete or rely on a file outside its lane, and raised the disposition to the lane that owns it. Following the finding surfaced a worse one in the tracked original that Lane B could not see from its own surface.
